title: Predicting consumer-technology ownership without a diffusion history
abstract: arXiv:2608.12344v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We test whether the perceived attributes of a consumer technology predict how widely it is owned. In a 2022 Prolific survey of US adults (n = 678), respondents rated 65 consumer technologies on six attributes. We then elicited the same ratings from two frontier language models, Anthropic Claude Opus 4.7 and OpenAI GPT-5.5. We regress ownership prevalence on four UTAUT2 acceptance attributes plus a log-age covariate with a sign-constrained penalized regression and evaluate it by holding out one technology at a time. The attribute model improves on a baseline of years-since-launch: mean absolute error falls by 17% with the human ratings, and by more with either model, most with Opus 4.7. Over the short 2022-to-2025 window, where ownership moved little, the same attributes do not improve on a no-change baseline. We set out the limitations of the approach, including the possibility that language-model ratings reflect prior knowledge of these

translated_title: 在没有扩散历史的情况下预测消费技术拥有率
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.12344v1 公告类型：新 摘要：我们测试了消费技术的感知属性是否能预测其被广泛拥有的程度。在2022年一项针对美国成年人的Prolific调查中（n = 678），受访者对65种消费技术在六个属性上进行了评分。随后，我们从两个前沿语言模型（Anthropic Claude Opus 4.7和OpenAI GPT-5.5）中获得了相同的评分。我们将拥有率对四个UTAUT2接受属性加上一个对数年龄协变量进行回归，使用符号约束惩罚回归，并通过每次留出一个技术来评估模型。属性模型优于以发布年数作为基线的模型：使用人类评分时，平均绝对误差下降了17%，而使用任一模型时下降更多，其中Opus 4.7效果最佳。在2022年至2025年的短暂窗口内，由于拥有率变化不大，相同的属性并未优于无变化基线。我们指出了该方法的局限性，包括语言模型评分可能反映其对这些技术的先验知识。
tldr: 本文发现消费技术的感知属性（尤其是通过语言模型评分）能显著提升没有扩散历史时对拥有率的预测，但仅在长期变化中有效，短期预测无优势。
en_tdlr: This paper finds that perceived attributes of consumer technologies, especially when rated by language models, significantly improve ownership prediction without diffusion history, but only for long-term changes, not short-term forecasts.
